concept: Scene rail, contextual stage-manager sheet, and openable prop drawer
prompt: High-fidelity Windows desktop battle-map editor in the approved theatre scene-and-cue world. Compact command bar; 14% Scenes rail; 70% painted fantasy stage map with crisp pixel pieces; openable bottom-right Prop Drawer; contextual selected-piece controls; narrow status line. Palette: stage black, cobalt, dusty rose, cue gold, warm white. Map remains unobstructed; Export PNG primary. Encounter statistics shown by the generated comp are explicitly out of scope and must not be implemented.
